fixed_paragraph: When someone asks for my help, I often decline if it doesn't benefit me. When a friend wants to borrow something, I usually say no because I value my possessions. When a colleague suggests a new idea, I often criticize it before considering its merits. When someone tries to change my mind, I stubbornly stick to my original opinion. When a group decision is being made, I push for my own preferences regardless of others' views. When someone shares their problems, I tend to dismiss them if they seem trivial to me. When a stranger approaches me for a favor, I typically refuse without hesitation. When a discussion gets heated, I don't shy away from confrontation. When someone disagrees with me, I argue my point until they relent.
